Makes a window as big as the desktop. [RestoreWindow](RestoreWindow) brings back the size it had before, and [WindowMaximized](WindowMaximized) says whether it is in this state.

```blitzbasic
;media interact windows/maximizewindow.png 2
Graphics 320, 240, 32, 2
win = CreateWindow("Maximized", 40, 40, 160, 100, Desktop(), 15)
MaximizeWindow win
Repeat
Until WaitEvent() = $803
```

![MaximizeWindow](media/windows/maximizewindow.png)
@param window  Handle of a window.
@gap The operating system maximizes the window, also when it was made without flag 2 and so cannot be resized by the user; without a window manager nothing happens. Where the windows are drawn inside the window of `Graphics`, the window fills that.
